subject: Commercial onboarding & billing readiness - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightpath.health>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@brightpath.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Platform onboarding & billing readiness

Alex / Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the procurement path moving:  

Key points from today's call:
- You liked the latency/cost profile for the clinical summarization workload and want to start a pilot with reserved capacity.
- Procurement path is the main gating item (paper process / PO vs card vs marketplace).
- Billing ops asked about invoice format, remit address, VAT handling, and net terms.

Items we need from BrightPath to unblock pilot kickoff:
1) Which commercial path do you want to start with? (Option A: BrightPath issues a PO to Redwood; Option B: Payment card for initial pilot charges; Option C: Purchase via AWS Marketplace listing — you mentioned interest but procurement prefers direct vendor route for now.)
2) Please share your PO template (so our vendor ops team can validate required fields).
3) Billing details for the invoice: remit address, VAT ID (if applicable), EIN, preferred invoice contact and email, and your standard net terms (Net30 / Net45 / Net60).
4) Any required invoice fields (PO number placement, line-item granularity, tax breakdown, department code).

Attached: redwood-commercial-terms-2026.pdf (commercial terms and standard invoicing fields).

If you can send the PO template and confirm preferred payment path by end of week, I’ll loop in our vendor ops team to confirm acceptance and outline timeline for issuing the first invoice.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
--Attachment: redwood-commercial-terms-2026.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightpath.health>

Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@brightpath.health>, procurement@brightpath.health
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Platform onboarding & billing readiness

Thanks Ben — good summary. Quick answers below (quoting key ask):

> 1) Which commercial path do you want to start with?
Procurement preference: Option A (PO to vendor). We want the contract/purchase to flow through our vendor onboarding first. We are evaluating Marketplace as a later operational option but prefer direct PO to get legal and tax paperwork completed first.

> 2) Please share your PO template
Attached: BrightPath_PO_Template.pdf — this includes our standard fields (PO#, Ship/Remit, Bill-to, department code, cost-center, approver).

> 3) Billing details for the invoice (remit address, VAT, EIN, net terms)
- Billing / Remit address: BrightPath Health, AP Dept., 410 Market St, Suite 1200, San Francisco, CA 94105
- EIN: 12-3456789
- VAT: N/A for US entity; FYI we have an EU affiliate (BrightPath Europe Ltd.) — if Redwood invoices the EU entity later, we will provide VAT number at that time.
- Standard net terms: We typically run Net30, but Jordan has confirmed we can discuss Net45 for strategic deals pending finance approval.
- Required fields: PO# on first line of invoice, itemized lines, tax/year info where applicable.

We attached the PO template. Let us know if Redwood needs any white-listing info for vendor onboarding (W9, insurance cert).

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Procurement Lead — BrightPath Health
--Attachment: BrightPath_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap: Platform onboarding & billing readiness (BrightPath PO template received)

Thanks for the forward, Ben — reviewed BrightPath's template and notes. Summary of what Vendor Ops needs and proposed routing: 

Vendor Ops assessment:
- PO template: acceptable. We need the PO to include (a) PO number, (b) billing/remit address, (c) EIN on the PO, and (d) unit price / SKU-level line items or an attached SOW that maps to invoice line items. BrightPath's template meets these requirements.
- Invoice requirements: our finance team requires invoice to list PO# on the first line, itemized SKU, invoice date, total, and remit address. For international VAT scenarios we can handle zero-rated or VAT-exempt invoices if the EU VAT ID is provided at the time of billing.
- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net30. For Net45 we require an approvals packet (deal owner summary + ARR threshold + finance sign-off). For pilot-stage deals we can approve Net45 on a case-by-case basis; requesting Ben to add expected monthly spend and any prepayment/commitment details so we can evaluate.
- Docs needed to complete vendor onboarding: W9, signed DPA (if data processing is in scope), COI (insurance) for contracts over $100k.

Action items for Ben (next 48 hours):
1) Ask BrightPath to issue PO with PO#, remit address, and EIN as they included.
2) Provide Vendor Ops the expected pilot monthly spend estimate and planned start date so we can review Net45 exception.
3) Send W9 and any procurement vendor form Redwood requires — I can share a quick checklist if helpful.

I’ve filled the PO with our internal vendor code in a stub (BrightPath_PO_Template_filled_stub.pdf) and uploaded the DocuSign link for the SOW/terms: https://www.docusign.com/sign/BrightPath-RW-2026. Once we have PO + spend estimate, Finance will queue the Net45 approval (if requested).

Priyom Das
Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference
